name: Iede Shoujo to Tome Otoko ~Shoujo no Negai to Otoko no Yokubou~
original_name: 家出少女と泊め男 ～少女の願いと男の欲棒～
source:
◆Introduction
"Can I stay here...? I have no place to go."
Starting with a single girl, many runaway girls start to visit the protagonist's house.
Although knowing it's wrong, but after hearing what they are going through...

◆Synopsis
The protagonist, Keigo Sagami, is a typical boring businessman.
While seeking to meet women, Keigo suddenly finds himself living with a runaway girl.
The girl's name was "Rio Shina".
As they live together, they begin to open up, but Keigo rejects Rio, feeling that they cannot continue this ambiguous relationship.

However, the days without Rio were very empty.
Then, many girls with different problems appear in front of Keigo.
"Akina Kobayakawa", a friend of Rio.
"Nagi Asama", a noble young girl who seeks freedom.

Keigo drowns into their charms, as if to fill a hole in his heart...
translation:
◆序言
“我可以留在这里吗……？我无处可去。”
从一名女孩开始，许多离家出走的女孩陆续来到主人公家中。
虽然知道这样不对，但听过她们的遭遇后……

◆剧情
主人公相模景吾是一名平凡无趣的上班族。
当他想与女性相遇时，突然开始和离家出走的女孩同居。
女孩名叫“椎名凛生”。

共同生活让两人逐渐敞开心扉，但圭吾觉得这种暧昧关系无法继续，拒绝了莉绪。

然而，没有莉绪的日子空虚至极。
随后，许多带着不同烦恼的女孩出现在圭吾面前。
“小早川晶菜”，莉绪的朋友。
“浅间凪”，追求自由的贵族千金。

圭吾仿佛要填补内心空洞一般，沉溺于她们的魅力……
